name: Gbbbs5
storyline: It's 1995, a long autumn weekend has just started and you got your brand new Gameboy Modem to go online. Experience the 90's world of dial-up Bulletin Board Systems, solve a small town mystery and explore a lush world in this cozy game backed by lofi hip hop vibes and midwestern emo inspired soundtrack. Massive original soundtrack by Beatscribe also includes a song by 90s math-rock slowcore legends C-Clamp and LoFi chill master A L E X.
summary: The internet has been shut down and your friend has been blamed for releasing a virus. Can you find proof to clear his name? A nostalgic cozy game inspired by memories of growing up in the 1990s.
